Maria K (PM): Heads-up — planning sync for next-quarter model onboarding. We have customer asks for a high-quality instruction-tuned 13B, a fast Mistral-style 7B, and updated embeddings from Mosaic. Need to decide sequencing and gating. Thoughts?
Sam R (Eng): my 2c: order by customer delta + infra fit. 13B instruction-tuned = high impact but medium effort (quant + perf tuning). Mistral-7b clone = low effort, high perf win. Mosaic embeddings = small infra work, big UX win for vector search customers.
Lee C (Research): Agree with Sam. Also flag: the 13B variant has known FLOP peaks with long contexts — will need KV cache validation and evictions tests. If we push it first without those tests we risk tail latency regressions.
Anita D (ProdOps): Launch criteria to keep in mind: 1) perf SLOs (p50/p95), 2) end-to-end canary on Dedicated, 3) automated rollback on regressions, 4) client docs + eval set passing. We should not ship a model on hosted without the canary safety net.
Maria K (PM): Can we apply RICE quickly so we can surface a ranked list for the roadmap doc? I sketched values below, please adjust.
Sam R (Eng): Share the sketch.
Maria K (PM): ```
Model                     Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort (pts)  RICE Score
13B instr-tuned           40     9       0.6         8             27
Mistral-like 7B           60     6       0.8         3             96
Mosaic embeddings         50     7       0.7         2             122
```
Sam R (Eng): Nice start. My tweak: confidence for 13B should be 0.5 given missing perf tests, effort 10 (kernel/quant work). That drops it to ~ (40*9*0.5)/10=18.
Lee C (Research): Also add quality risk multiplier: instruction tuning sometimes regresses on safety evals — add a soft veto unless safety pass >= 0.95.
Anita D (ProdOps): Practically, that means timeline: Mistral-like 7B can go first (fast lift, big infra win), Mosaic embeddings second (low risk, quick customer value), 13B last once perf + safety gates clear. That order aligns with minimizing outage & cost risk.
Maria K (PM): OK — I'll draft roadmap slice: Q2 sprint 1 = Mistral-7b rollout (hosted + dedicated pilot), sprint 2 = Mosaic embeddings (hosted embeddings API + tests), sprint 3 = 13B instr-tuned (gated). Anyone opposed?
Sam R (Eng): +1. Need to reserve a Dedicated pool for the 13B workbench when we start to tune; otherwise scheduling will block us.
Lee C (Research): I'll own the safety/evals for 13B and provide a pass/fail scorecard before sprint 3 kickoff.
deploy-bot: deploy status: canary cluster for mistral-7b prototype created (job id: deploy-7782) :white_check_mark:
Anita D (ProdOps): I'll create the rollout policy doc and canary checklist. Also propose a rollback SLA: if p95 latency degrades >20% or error rate +0.5% within first 24h, auto-fallback to previous model variant.
Maria K (PM): Perfect — I'll update the product roadmap doc and add RICE numbers + safety veto note. We'll present this at the roadmap review on Wednesday. Thanks team. :rocket:
